title: Sharp Hausdorff Bounds for the Interior Singular Set of Convex $k$-Hessian Solutions
summary: Let $2\le k\le n$, let $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be open and convex, and let $u$ be a convex viscosity solution of $σ_k(D^2u)=1$ in $Ω$. We prove that the set on which $u$ fails to be locally $C^2$ has vanishing $(n-1)$-dimensional Hausdorff measure. In the intermediate range $3\le k 0$, we obtain Hausdorff bounds for strata defined by the affine dimension of all supporting contact sets. The proof combines a support-dependent Chou--Wang barrier argument, an estimate for the product of the smallest $k$ semiaxes of a John ellipsoid, and Mooney's convex section-covering theorem.
